fabric-api-base.reason: Shipped by Fabricated (vendored from upstream); every Fabric API module builds on it.

fabric-api-lookup-api-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated (unchanged from upstream) because its transfer API builds on it.

fabric-biome-api-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated: upstream's API and biome source mixins, with biome modifications applied as a NeoForge biome modifier (upstream replaces biome fields NeoForge keeps private and no longer reads, and its weather changes read a field NeoForge's coremod keeps private).

fabric-block-api-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's block hooks (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches); NeoForge's own chunk-section air check is kept.

fabric-content-registries-v0.reason: Shipped by Fabricated: upstream's registries and mixins, with NeoForge's data maps backed by them where an entry is missing.

fabric-crash-report-info-v1.reason: NeoForge already lists every mod in crash reports; nothing else to provide.

fabric-dimensions-v1.reason: DataFixerUpper is a library NeoForge loads without mixin support, so the safety net for worlds that reference a removed modded dimension is not available.

fabric-entity-events-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's entity events (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches); elytra and most sleep events are not fired.

fabric-events-interaction-v0.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's interaction events (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches); attack entity callbacks get no hit result, and client-side cancelled interactions still reach the server.

fabric-item-api-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's item hooks and events (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches); equipment slot providers get no entity, tooltip appenders are added after the other tooltip lines.

fabric-lifecycle-events-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's events (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches).

fabric-loot-api-v3.reason: Shipped by Fabricated: upstream's builder and drop mixins as they are, its loading hook replaced by NeoForge's LootTableLoadEvent (upstream's conflicts with NeoForge's loot loading).

fabric-networking-api-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's payload system (login queries are not supported).

fabric-object-builder-api-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's registration events (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches); custom minecart comparator logic is not used by detector rails; trades are replayed through NeoForge's trade events.

fabric-registry-sync-v0.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's registries, which already sync ids to clients (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches).

fabric-resource-conditions-api-v1.reason: NeoForge decides whether data files and registry entries load with its own conditions: Fabricated evaluates fabric:load_conditions there, with upstream's conditions, instead of upstream's mixins on the code NeoForge rewrote.

fabric-resource-loader-v0.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's reload-listener and pack-finder events (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches).

fabric-screen-handler-api-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's menu opening data: extended menus send their opening data the way NeoForge mods' menus do (upstream's mixins target the openMenu NeoForge replaced).

fabric-tag-api-v1.reason: NeoForge tag files already have a remove list, which NeoForge applies: Fabricated adds fabric:remove entries to it instead of upstream's own removal handling.

fabric-transfer-api-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated: upstream's API and mixins, with the container mixins reworked onto NeoForge's transaction-aware setItem; NeoForge hoppers don't see Fabric-only storages yet.
